# Notifications and email

<!-- Generated by `bogey docs` from packages/config/src/notifications.ts and email.ts. Do not edit manually. -->

Everything Bogey tells people about. Each notification shows in the bell, goes by email, or both; people choose
under Account → Notifications, except for the ones marked *always sent*, which say where they stand.
Plugins add their own as `<plugin>.<kind>`.

## Notifications

| Key | Name | Group | Default | Email | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `registration.received` | Registration received | Registration | bell and email | always sent | Your registration is waiting for an organizer. |
| `registration.approved` | Registration approved | Registration | bell and email | always sent | You're in. |
| `registration.rejected` | Registration declined | Registration | bell and email | always sent | An organizer couldn't accept your registration. |
| `registration.waitlisted` | Waitlisted | Registration | bell and email | always sent | The event is full and you're on the waitlist. |
| `team.joined` | Someone joined your team | Teams | bell | can be turned off | A new member joined a team you're on. |
| `team.left` | Someone left your team | Teams | bell | can be turned off | A member left a team you're on. |
| `team.request` | Requests to join | Teams | bell and email | can be turned off | Someone asks to join a team you captain. |
| `team.invited` | Team invitations | Teams | bell and email | can be turned off | A team invites you to join. |
| `team.answered` | Answers to requests and invitations | Teams | bell | can be turned off | A team or person answered your request or invitation. |
| `judging.assigned` | Projects to judge | Judging | bell and email | can be turned off | Projects were assigned to you. |
| `judging.advanced` | Advanced to the next round | Judging | bell and email | can be turned off | Your project is a finalist. |
| `submission.received` | Submission received | Submissions | bell and email | can be turned off | Your team's project was submitted. |
| `submission.deadline` | Submission deadline | Submissions | bell and email | can be turned off | Your team still has only a draft as the deadline nears. |
| `results.published` | Results published | Submissions | bell and email | can be turned off | The results are out. |
| `announcement` | Announcements | Event | bell | can be turned off | An organizer posted an announcement. |
| `checkin.badge` | Check-in code | Event | bell and email | can be turned off | Your code for the check-in desk, before the event. |
| `certificate.issued` | Certificates | Event | bell and email | can be turned off | A certificate for you is ready. |
| `session.reminder` | Session reminders | Event | bell | can be turned off | A session you signed up for is about to start. |
| `window.reminder` | Schedule reminders | Event | bell | can be turned off | Something on the event's schedule, like submissions or judging, is about to open. |

## Email wording

Organizers edit the subject and body of each email under Instance, Organization and Event → Email, using these variables.

| Key | Name | Variables | Sent when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signIn` | Sign-in | `{{code}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent when someone signs in. |
| `signUp` | Account confirmation | `{{code}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent when someone creates an account. |
| `invite` | Invitation | `{{code}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent when someone is invited to create an account. |
| `emailChange` | Email change | `{{code}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to confirm a new email address. |
| `reauthentication` | Confirm it's you | `{{code}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent before a sensitive change, to check it's really the account's owner. |
| `registration.received` | Registration received | `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent when someone registers and an organizer still has to approve them. |
| `registration.approved` | Registration approved | `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}`, `{{note}}` | Sent when a registration is approved. |
| `registration.rejected` | Registration declined | `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}`, `{{note}}` | Sent when a registration is declined. |
| `registration.waitlisted` | Waitlisted | `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}`, `{{note}}` | Sent when an event is full and someone joins the waitlist. |
| `event.invite` | Event invitation | `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent when someone is invited to an event. |
| `team.invite` | Team invitation | `{{team}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent when someone is invited to join a team. |
| `team.joined` | Someone joined your team | `{{team}}`, `{{member}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to a team when a new member joins. |
| `judging.assigned` | Projects to judge | `{{count}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to a judge when projects are assigned to them. |
| `judging.advanced` | Finalist | `{{project}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to a team when its project moves on to the next round. |
| `submission.received` | Submission received | `{{project}}`, `{{team}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to a team when its project is submitted. |
| `submission.deadline` | Submission deadline | `{{project}}`, `{{when}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to teams that have only a draft as the deadline nears. |
| `results.published` | Results published | `{{award}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent to participants when results are published. |
| `announcement` | Announcement | `{{title}}`, `{{body}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent with an announcement when the organizer chooses to also email it. |
| `checkin.badge` | Check-in badge | `{{when}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent before the event with a link to the person's check-in code. |
| `session.reminder` | Session reminder | `{{session}}`, `{{when}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent shortly before a session a person signed up for. |
| `notification` | Plugin notification | `{{title}}`, `{{body}}`, `{{event}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{org}}`, `{{platform}}`, `{{email}}` | Sent for notifications from plugins that don't have an email of their own. |
